name: Japanese tea house
summary: The raised timber base, paper-screen openings and stone-lantern garden read as a tea house, but the roof is a ragged, hole-ridden pile of dark bricks with no hipped-and-gabled form or curved eaves, and the stray red blocks wreck the look.

log.summary: The raised timber base, garden and lantern read as a tea house, but the roof is a ragged stepped pile of blackstone with holes and no curved eaves, and a giant red blob on one corner ruins the silhouette.
